name: Know-nothing Noelle
source:
Perilously close to failing her senior year, Noelle is overworked and pressured by expectations into cheating on an exam. After being caught in the act by her teacher, Noelle finds that he isn’t as well-intentioned as he seems.

Or at all, really.

But unable to afford repeating the year, she isn’t exactly in a place to refuse extracurricular lessons in exchange for favors…no matter how questionable said favors are.

So, what to do when you’re blackmailed into doing your teacher’s bidding? Will Noelle bend and buckle or stand up for herself? Survive until graduation or fail miserably trying!

[From [url=https://catsix.itch.io/know-nothing-noelle]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺艾尔高三时差一点就挂科了，她工作过度，在期望的压力下考试作弊。被老师发现后，诺艾尔发现老师并不像看上去那么好意。

或者根本没有，真的。

但由于无力承担留级费用，她也不适合拒绝课外课程以换取好处……无论所说的好处有多么可疑。

那么，当你被勒索要听从老师的命令时该怎么办？诺艾尔会弯腰屈服还是为自己挺身而出？要么生存到毕业，要么尝试惨遭失败！

[来自[url=https://catsix.itch.io/know-nothing-noelle]itch.io[/url]]
